React · Redux & state management

What is Redux, and why do we need it?

Answer

Redux is a predictable state container: the whole app's global state lives in a single store, and it can only change by dispatching actions handled by pure reducers.

Why we need it:

  • Many components across the tree share and update the same data (user, cart, permissions).
  • Avoids prop drilling and scattered state.
  • Predictable, traceable updates (Redux DevTools, time-travel debugging, logging).
  • Middleware for async logic and side effects; clear patterns for large teams.

Not every app needs it — server state is often better handled by RTK Query / React Query, and local UI state by useState.
